name: read-file
description: Tests the read_file tool by asking the agent to read a real source file and explain its contents. The agent must use read_file on ShellTool.swift and correctly identify the ShellToolArgs parameters (command, workingDirectory, timeout) and their types.
task: Read the file at Sources/Yrden/Tools/ShellTool.swift and explain what parameters the ShellToolArgs struct accepts. For each parameter, tell me the property name, its Swift type, whether it's optional, and the description string from the @Guide annotation.
